response.title: which robot mower is hardest to steal
response.answer:
If your main concern is someone picking up your robotic lawn mower and stealing it, I'd prioritize models with cellular GPS tracking, theft alerts, PIN protection, and account locking.

The key distinction is between preventing theft and recovering a stolen mower. Most robotic mowers can physically be carried away. The best anti-theft systems make the mower traceable and difficult to reuse or resell.

My top brands to investigate are Husqvarna Automower, Mammotion LUBA, and Segway Navimow.

Lift alarm, GPS/4G tracking and support for an additional AirTag. A strong alternative if you also need all-wheel-drive performance. 
MowTech

My conclusion: Husqvarna is my choice for making a stolen mower difficult to use again. Segway X4 may have the advantage for recovering one, thanks to Apple Find My. Neither is physically theft-proof, and there isn't reliable comparative theft-rate data establishing a definitive winner.

One important question: Are you planning to use the mower in an unfenced front yard where anyone walking past could pick it up?

That would change which security features I'd prioritize.
